messages:
marta: quick copy review: modal for 'Request more quota' is going into the Console. want to settle wording before eng wires it. current draft below.

marta: Current draft:
Title: Request higher quota
Body: You can request an increase to your API quota. Requests are reviewed within 2 business days.
Primary: Request increase
Secondary: Cancel

marta: concerns: 'quota' might be jargon for some users, the CTA is a bit passive, and we should consider explaining what the review involves (e.g., usage checks).

jamal: +1. 'quota' is ok in product teams but docs show users search for 'limits' more often. maybe use 'API limit' or show both: "quota (API limits)".

jamal: alternative title: Request a higher API limit
Body alt: Well review your request and respond within 2 business days. We may ask for details about your use case and expected traffic.
Primary: Submit request
Secondary: Not now

erin: I prefer 'Submit request' for the CTA. also we should avoid passive phrasing like 'are reviewed'  make it active: 'Our team reviews requests within 2 business days.'

erin: accessibility nit: if we include time windows, clarify timezone or say 'business days (MonFri)'. also add aria-describedby linking to the help doc: `/docs/quota-requests`.

laura: tone: keep it low-friction. mention what happens after approval (e.g., "limit increases roll out within 1 hour"). that gives users a sense of timing. maybe add an optional field label: 'Use case (optional)'.

marta: updated suggestion based on feedback:
Title: Request a higher API limit
Body: Tell us how youll use the extra capacity (optional). Our team reviews requests within 2 business days and may follow up for more details. Approved increases typically apply within 1 hour.
Primary: Submit request
Secondary: Cancel

marta: also thinking about a microcopy line on the form input: 'Examples: background batch jobs, higher concurrency for production rollout'. keeps examples short.

jamal: love the examples. micro nit: use single quotes consistently or none. keep plain punctuation.

erin: small accessibility ask: primary button label should read fully for screen readers: 'Submit quota increase request' via aria-label. avoid truncation.

design-bot: microcopy checklist: avoid jargon, prefer active voice, include timelines when possible, mark optional fields, link to policy with rel=noopener. modal focus and dismissal patterns: pressing Esc closes modal, but also confirm secondary is keyboard-focusable.

marta: nice. i'll land the copy as above, add the examples, and update the Figma form fields + aria-label per Erin. i'll open a brief ticket linking doc for the help page. if no objections by EOD i'll pass to PM. :sparkles:

jamal: :thumbsup:

erin: looks good to me.

laura: happy with this. one last tiny ask: change '1 hour' to 'up to 1 hour' to be realistic.

marta: done  updated in Figma to 'up to 1 hour'. thanks all!
